primary_text: 1949 Jordan agreement V(1)(c) assigns the Hebron–Dead Sea sector to Annex I Map1 section B. V(1)(d) MR1925-0958 concerns the separate Dead Sea-to-southernmost-Palestine sector.
historical_validation: Not established: the retained UNTS42 PDF has only the north sheet, not Map1 sectionB/south sheet. Modern source agreement does not authenticate the 1949 water crossing. No endpoint was moved and no guessed historical connector was added.
